projects.title: MD5 Humanitarian & Disaster Relief Hackathon - Austin, TX
projects.description:
Project Name: 911 Backlogs AI

Project Summary: During an emergency or disaster, emergency dispatchers get overwhelmed by the chaos that ensues as numerous calls for help flood in. This causes many inefficiencies, as sometimes multiple calls come in for the same incident, and other potentially critical incidents don’t get acknowledged in time, leaving people stuck in dangerous situations. To aid dispatchers, and to ensure that all calls get received, we developed a system to receive phone calls simultaneously, analyze the call, and convert the message into actionable insights by prioritizing, grouping and pinpointing the location of the emergency to enable dispatchers to respond to the most important calls first. The idea is to eventually implement IBM Watson or other machine learning systems to recognize the call, extract necessary information by asking appropriate questions, prioritize the situation accordingly, and make predictions for further actions and probable results.

Personal Responsibilities: Front-end design and functionality, utilizing HTML, CSS and Bootstrap for layout and Adobe Photoshop to create visual header and footer banner graphics, manage merging of changes through GitHub

Technology Summary: Python, Django, SQLite, Google Voice, IMAP, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Adobe Photoshop
